headword: {日照時間|にっしょうじかん}
gloss: hours of sunshine; hours of daylight

definitions.gloss: hours of sunshine; hours of daylight
definitions.explanation: The length of time during which direct sunlight reaches the ground in a given day or period. A meteorological term also used in farming and real estate.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{日照時間|にっしょうじかん}が{短|みじか}い。
examples.english: Today the hours of sunshine are short.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{日照時間|にっしょうじかん}が{少|すく}なくなる。
examples.english: In winter the hours of daylight decrease.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{日照時間|にっしょうじかん}が{長|なが}く、{野菜|やさい}がよく{育|そだ}つ。
examples.english: This region has long hours of sunshine, so vegetables grow well.

notes:
Composed of {日照|にっしょう} ('sunshine') + {時間|じかん} ('time'). A meteorological measure that is also relevant to farming, gardening, and real estate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日照時間|にっしょうじかん}が{長|なが}い / {短|みじか}い: long / short hours of sunshine
- {年間|ねんかん}{日照時間|にっしょうじかん}: annual hours of sunshine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日当|ひあ}たり: sunlight exposure of a place — how much sun a particular spot receives
